en: A monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of a rural town in a valley, surrounded by fields and rolling hills. Numerous small houses and farm buildings are visible, along with a larger complex in the middle distance. In the far left, a church with a tower rises above the town. Leafless or sparsely leaved trees frame the right foreground. The caption "Andritz bei Graz." is printed in the upper left corner in a serif typeface.
